scope: All EvidenceOps innovations, algorithms, agents, products, control planes and deployment lanes
truth_rule: Maturity is evidence-bound. Design, source presence, local tests, documentation, issue text or intent may not be promoted as runtime, provider, production or consequential proof.

levels.name: REAL_WORKFLOW_CALIBRATED
required_evidence: cross-implementation or independent verification where material

hard_guards: no runtime inference from source or local tests
no consequential external action above granted authority
no promotion on generic HTTP/queue/health success
no production-mature claim while a P0 security or provider-authority blocker materially affects the capability

forbidden_shortcuts: provider success inferred from repository success
generic success substituted for requested action proof

priority_formula: priority = impact * reuse * decision_criticality * maturity_gap * blocker_reducibility / (risk + owner_burden + external_dependency)
completion_definition: Every in-scope innovation is either M8 PRODUCTION_MATURE with current evidence, RETIRED with migration proof, or explicitly BLOCKED with a named external dependency and no false completion claim.
